metadata.project: Bénin AgroMarket — Prévision des prix vivriers au Bénin

evaluation_protocol.holdout_test_split: 2025-10-15..2026-09-15 (12 target months per horizon, evaluated once)
safeguards: Safeguard 1: Full-sample outlier diagnostics (robust_z, is_outlier_*) are never used as model inputs.
Safeguard 2: Only months with is_observed == 1 are ever used as forecast targets.
